## Conflicting permission tokens (`perm_conflict`)

| token A | token B | reason (en) | active |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cash_move` | `accounts_manage` | The person who records cash moves should not also edit the ledger or journal | yes |
| `closed_period_edit` | `accounts_manage` | Editing closed periods together with the ledger is risky | yes |
| `item_bulk` | `change_approve` | The person who changes items in bulk should not approve changes | yes |
| `payroll_manage` | `salary_manage` | Setting pay structures and paying salaries should be two people | yes |
| `purchase_entry` | `purchase_void` | If the same person enters and voids a bill, mistakes are hard to catch | yes |
| `purchase_entry` | `supplier_pay` | The person who enters purchase bills should not also pay suppliers | yes |
| `recipe_manage` | `recipe_approve` | The person who edits a recipe should not approve it | yes |
| `role:intake_bot` | `form:POS` | An intake bot should not enter or use POS | yes |
| `role:intake_bot` | `module:pos` | An intake bot should hold no POS right | yes |
| `sale_void` | `stock_count_adjust` | Voiding sales and adjusting stock counts together can hide a shortage | yes |
| `sell_below_zero` | `stock_count_adjust` | Selling beyond stock and adjusting counts together can cover up differences | yes |
| `supplier_pay` | `accounts_manage` | Paying suppliers and editing the ledger should not be in one person's hands | yes |
| `view_cost` | `discount_over_limit` | Seeing cost and giving discounts above the limit should not go together | yes |
| `view_cost` | `price_override` | Seeing cost and changing prices together makes it easy to set prices privately | yes |
| `wastage_write_off` | `wastage_approve` | The person who writes off wastage should not approve large write-offs | yes |
